scenes.title: Birthday Morning
scenes.summary: Katya catches Senya and Fedya goofing off before Claude Monet opens, while at Arcobaleno the kitchen staff congratulates Chef Barinov on his birthday.

scenes.title: A Buffet for Leopards
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov invites his ex-wife Tanya and daughter Alisa to Arcobaleno for his birthday at eight, only to learn Elena booked a leopard charity buffet.

scenes.title: The Irony of Life
scenes.summary: Elena Pavlovna explains that the leopard charity brings tax breaks to the restaurant, while Barinov pretends to his friends that everything is fine.

scenes.title: The Stolen Blue Cheese
scenes.summary: Katya discovers that someone stole expensive blue cheese from the fridge, and Senya slyly blames the thefts on newcomer Denis.

scenes.title: A Bouquet for Ainura
scenes.summary: German tries to give Vika the stray bouquet of flowers with a romantic speech, and when Vika refuses them, he hands them to Ainura.

scenes.title: Miracle Drops as a Gift
scenes.summary: Senya, Fedya, and Louis pool money for Chef Barinov's birthday gift, and Senya shows off Timur's miracle love drops until German catches them.

scenes.title: A Table at Claude Monet
scenes.summary: Unable to book any restaurant in Moscow on a Friday evening, Chef Barinov swallows his pride and comes to Claude Monet to book a table.

scenes.title: An Expensive Watch from Nagiyev
scenes.summary: German insults Chef Barinov in the dining room until Barinov gets a birthday call from owner Dmitry Nagiyev promising a two-hundred-thousand-ruble watch.

scenes.title: The Chef's Dangerous Daughter
scenes.summary: Katya searches Denis in the fridge thinking he is stealing food, and Senya and Fedya convince Denis that Katya is a predatory nymphomaniac.

scenes.title: Sudden Health Inspection
scenes.summary: Just as Vika promises Chef Barinov a smooth birthday evening, a sanitary inspector shuts down Claude Monet after finding rodents.

scenes.title: Undercover Celebration
scenes.summary: With forty minutes until his birthday guests arrive, Chef Barinov hijacks the leopard charity gala at Arcobaleno and locks the organizer in a closet.

scenes.title: Ordered to Stay Late
scenes.summary: When the Claude Monet cooks ask to leave early since the restaurant is closed, German spitefully orders two cooks and the waiters to work late.

scenes.title: The Year of the Leopard
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov welcomes his friends, ex-wife Tanya, and daughter Alisa to Arcobaleno and claims the leopard banners are for the Year of the Leopard.

scenes.title: Five Hundred Thousand in an Envelope
scenes.summary: A charity donor asks Senya where to leave his contribution and mentions putting in five hundred, which Senya mistakes for five hundred rubles.

scenes.title: Oysters and Wine in the Office
scenes.summary: German invites Vika to relax over oysters and wine in his office, and when he sends for wine, Ainura thinks German is inviting her for romance.

scenes.title: Showdown in the Walk-in Fridge
scenes.summary: Cornered by Katya in the walk-in fridge, Denis offers to sleep with her so she will stop following him, and both realize Senya and Fedya pranked them.

scenes.title: Busted at the Party
scenes.summary: During Chef Barinov's toast at Arcobaleno, Senya picks a fight with two charity guests who insult Barinov, exposing the fake birthday party.

scenes.title: The Best Birthday Ever
scenes.summary: Outside Arcobaleno, Chef Barinov apologizes to his family and friends, Alisa calls it his best birthday ever, and Katya arrives with whiskey.

scenes.title: Surprise in the Dark Office
scenes.summary: German finds Ainura waiting romantically in his office just as Chef Barinov's crew arrives, and Vika invites everyone to stay.

scenes.title: A Toast to the Chef
scenes.summary: The whole brigade sets a warm birthday table for Chef Barinov, invites German to join them, and raises a joyous toast to the Chef.
